# TracedOptions interface

Options for the [traced()](/api/datadog/latest/datadog.traced/) method decorator. Every field is optional at the call site — `traced()` takes a `Partial` of this and fills the rest in.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface TracedOptions 
```
